mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above a 5% year-over-year growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by > 300k and UNRATE decreases by > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1 million units signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1 million units.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show a quarter-over-quarter growth rate below 1%, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 show QoQ growth below 1%.
